runs.prompt: Add a method Clear to Cart in cart/cart.go that removes every line, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Cart.Clear()` to remove every line. The new test checks that the cart is empty, its subtotal is zero, and it can be used again. I also added the requirement entry.

`go test ./cart` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a method Preview to Checkout in cart/checkout.go that takes the same session token, cart and discount as PlaceOrder and returns the quote that PlaceOrder would charge, without reserving stock or charging. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Checkout.Preview` in [checkout.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-02/repo/cart/checkout.go). It uses the same session validation and pricing path as `PlaceOrder`, returning the quote without reserving stock or charging.

Added tests for quote parity, side effects, and invalid inputs in [checkout_test.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-02/repo/cart/checkout_test.go). `go test ./cart` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a method Held to Stock in inventory/inventory.go that returns the units of a SKU that unexpired reservations hold, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Stock.Held(sku)` to return the units held by unexpired reservations. `Available` now uses the same hold calculation, and the new test covers multiple reservations, unrelated SKUs, and expiry boundaries.

`go test ./inventory` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a method Logout to Sessions in accounts/session.go that ends a session, so that validating its token afterwards fails with ErrNoSession. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Sessions.Logout(token)` to end a session. The new test confirms that validating the token afterward returns `ErrNoSession`.

`go test ./accounts ./cart` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a method Total to AuditLog in payments/audit.go that returns the sum of the amounts of one account's entries for one action, such as "charge" or "refund". Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `AuditLog.Total(account, action)`, which sums matching entry amounts in cents under the log’s mutex. Tests cover multiple entries, account and action filtering, and no matches.

`go test ./payments` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a method Expired to Discount in pricing/discount.go that reports whether the code has expired at a given time, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Discount.Expired(now)` in [pricing/discount.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-06/repo/pricing/discount.go). It returns true at and after the expiry time, and `ApplyDiscount` now uses it. Added tests for before, exactly at, and after expiry.

`go test ./...` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a function ParseMoney to pricing/money.go that parses an amount such as 12.05 into Money and rejects more than two decimal places. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `ParseMoney` in [pricing/money.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-07/repo/pricing/money.go). It converts decimal text directly to integer cents and rejects more than two decimal places, invalid input, and overflow.

Added tests in [money_test.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-07/repo/pricing/money_test.go). `go test ./...` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a String method to Quote in pricing/quote.go that formats a quote as "subtotal 10.00, discount 1.00, tax 1.35, total 10.35", and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Quote.String()` in [quote.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-08/repo/pricing/quote.go) to format the four amounts as requested, with an exact-output test in [quote_test.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-08/repo/pricing/quote_test.go).

`go test ./pricing` passes.

runs.prompt: Add a function RatePercent to pricing/tax.go that formats a region's rate as a percentage, such as 14.975%, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `RatePercent` in [pricing/tax.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-09/repo/pricing/tax.go). It formats `RatePPM` with integer arithmetic, so `149_750` becomes `14.975%` and trailing zeros are omitted.

Added tests in [pricing/tax_test.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T12.1/run-09/repo/pricing/tax_test.go). `go test ./pricing` passes.
